Page 45 Cont.
Aug. 13 Mrs. L. Crawford - 40 - raised Orthodox - husband Methodist - inter- nal cancer - science hopeless .... Enrolls for 50c promises to look in- to religion. ...
Albert Banman - 2 - had fearful convultions July 14; unconscious ever since.
14 Simon Bida - 25 Psicopathic inclined since early childhood; since last Fall after severe injuries on head has been so more pronounced. Has not been to confession in year and a half. Promises to go To- day is enrolled in S.M.A.
Page 46 Aug. 15 Shellie Cordner - 54 - for years arthritis now dying of Cancer -hope- less in Alexendria, Virginia % phone.
Henry Shepan - 43 - Baptist - Mt Clemens - Fearful condition of Eyes - nearly out of mind with pain. Drs having removed a bad goitre and something like brain tuomer, say the case is hopeless .... Promises to read a book of Mystical City of God if sight is restored. Thank God he seems decidedly better before leaving .... His condition was alarm- ing half hour ago. I was scared. Now he is calm. Deo Gratias Ida Bakes - 32 - Nerve-break .... St. Jo's Ret.
18 Eugene Griffin - 19 - Auto crash Sunday a.m .... still unconscious .... Ann Sharble - 41 - heart trouble
Ralph Black - 2324 Norwalk - wants girl - woman to care for children ..
19 Mrs. Cath. Houle - 37 - troubled with ear since S yrs. old. 14 doctors have treated case. They fear possible transfer to other ear ...
Mary Lengyel - 8 - Greek Orthodox - bright and alert in many ways, but still not normal, believed to have received birth injuries. En- rolled To-day (2.00)
Page 47 Aug. 19 Mrs. Betty Haney - 31 of Toledo, Ohio - unconscious since a year ago Aug. 10th. Her nurse here To-day - had accident on that date - hus- band's mother - non c. - was killed at time.
Mrs. Anna Matuszewski - 74 - cancer in cheek and otherwise internal. Drs. hopeless. Enrolls Today 5.
